interpretation: Mechanism evidence and compartment limits; no transferable vaccine rate constants

studies.scope: Human pre-nodal lymph and matched plasma; pooled samples from 18 individuals
studies.finding: Lymph carries a distinct tissue-derived peptide repertoire, including extracellular-matrix products
studies.limit: Products may be generated upstream in tissue; they do not identify active free-fluid enzymes or vaccine hazards

studies.scope: Experimental dendritic-cell MHC-II peptidome and lymph-derived self-antigens
studies.finding: Tissue-processed lymph antigens contribute to MHC-II ligands through pathways beyond endosomal proteolysis
studies.limit: No arbitrary-SLP transport, protease or loading rate is identified

studies.scope: Anesthetized C57BL/6J mice, mesenteric lymph, GLP-1 and DPP4 activity assay
studies.finding: Lymph has measurable DPP4 activity lower than plasma; inhibition increases intact lymph GLP-1
studies.limit: Abstract and results give different lymph summaries; neither is an inverse-hour peptide hazard. No human IM/SC or SLP scaling factor is inferred

studies.scope: Cultured human dermal lymphatic versus blood endothelial cells; human tissue localization
studies.finding: DPP4 activity is higher in cultured lymphatic endothelium; lymphatic expression is observed in tissue
studies.limit: Surface exposure differs from soluble-fluid activity; no SLP hazard or universal lymph/plasma ratio

studies.scope: Melan-A synthetic long peptide and human dendritic cells
studies.finding: This SLP uses proteasome/TAP-dependent cytosolic cross-presentation
studies.limit: Sequence- and cell-scoped mechanism; not a universal cross-presentation probability

studies.scope: Mouse dendritic cells, soluble OVA plus phagocytic stimulation
studies.finding: Cathepsin-S-dependent, TAP-independent MHC-I cross-presentation is observed
studies.limit: Condition-dependent route; not quantitatively transferable to human SLPs

studies.scope: Albumin-binding amphiphile vaccines; mouse trafficking/presentation and human DC processing
studies.finding: Formulation changes lymphatic distribution and presentation persistence versus soluble peptides
studies.limit: Label/carrier signal is not automatically intact target; amphiphile rates cannot be assigned to free SLPs

studies.scope: Intravenous RNA-lipoplexes in mice; secretion-tagged antigen and serum detection
studies.finding: RNA-transfected cells can express and secrete serum-detectable antigen
studies.limit: Different carrier/route from local mRNA-LNP; a signal peptide does not establish secretion yield or timing

studies.scope: Mouse mRNA-LNP vaccination with genetically dissected APC pathways
studies.finding: Direct presentation, cross-presentation and preformed-pMHC transfer can contribute to CD8 priming
studies.limit: Cross-dressing is excluded from the first trajectory model; APC processing alone may miss this contribution
